name: Flight Master's Whistle has its 30 minute cooldown (COA-7253)
contract: Using the Flight Master's Whistle (item 10) casts spell 158, whose client data gives it a 30 minute cooldown. The item row no longer overrides that with 0, so right after a use the whistle is on cooldown.

steps.label: the whistle is on its 30 minute cooldown
